summary: Implemented the voluptuous core under voluptuous/: Schema compilation for dicts, objects, lists, tuples and sets, the Required/Optional/Exclusive/Inclusive/Remove markers, the Any/All/Union/SomeOf combinators, the built-in validators and util helpers, error path handling, humanize_error and the validate decorator. The last full-suite run (c0-test voluptuous/tests) gave 148 passed and 0 failed, and the markdown spec and module docstring doctests also pass.
